I have resolved the issue where sliced querysets used with [`Prefetch`](file:///testbed/django/db/models/query.py#L2142) objects failed late with an error during evaluation rather than validating cleanly upon initialization.

### Summary of Changes

- In [`Prefetch.__init__`](file:///testbed/django/db/models/query.py#L2143-L2167) in [django/db/models/query.py](file:///testbed/django/db/models/query.py), added a check for `queryset.query.is_sliced` to raise a `ValueError("Prefetch querysets cannot use slices.")` when a sliced queryset is provided.
